maya: CI red on golden-tests: a bunch of snapshot mismatches under render_serialization/* — looks like field ordering changed in the serialized output. cc @jon @ravi can someone triage? failing job: https://ci.redwood/12345
ci-bot: Build 12345 failed: golden-tests (render_serialization) — failing tests: render_serialization/response_metadata_order, render_serialization/kv_prefix_spacing. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/logs
jon: On it. quick question: did any PR touching serializer/response formatter land yesterday? searching commits in range b3f9a..c2d1e
maya: I think PR #4127 (ravi) changed Response.to_json ordering — might be the culprit. Ravi, did you intentionally change deterministic ordering or rely on Python dict iteration?
ravi: I flipped map serialization to preserve insertion order coming from the model, to make outputs more predictable for some new evals. I didn't think about backward-compat for existing golds. Reverting is meh. Can we bisect or rerun targeted tests to confirm?
linh: Quick local repro: `./dev/run_golden.sh render_serialization --seed=42` shows the same diffs for me. For CI: `ci rerun 12345 --tests "render_serialization/*" --attempt=1` is fastest.
jon: I'll kick off a CI bisect: `ci bisect --job golden-tests --base b3f9a --head c2d1e --test render_serialization/response_metadata_order` and report back. If it points to #4127 we can either revert or add a compatibility toggle.
ci-bot: Triggered rerun 12346 for selected tests (requested by jon). Logs: https://ci.redwood/12346/logs — status: started.
maya: :thumbsup: Note: do NOT regenerate golds automatically if this is a serialization change. We need product/QA signoff for any intentional output changes. Add an eval check too.
jon: Bisect finished — first bad commit is c1a2b (part of PR #4127). Short diff excerpt:
```
- "features": {"a": 1, "b": 2}
+ "features": {"b": 2, "a": 1}
```
Seems ordering reversed for nested maps. I'll open a follow-up to add a compatibility flag and tests.
ravi: OK thanks — pushing a patch that makes the new ordering opt-in via `RESPONSE_SERIALIZE_PRESERVE_INSERTION=true` and adding a unit test that locks the default to previous behavior. ETA ~30m.
maya: Perfect. Filing a quick ops note in eng-platform with CI links and keeping this thread as the triage trail.
